subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` remain a built-in-OpenClaw-only setting that fails before model execution when a Codex or plugin harness is selected?
rationale: The branch deliberately avoids adding a new plugin-harness API, while the alternative would establish a broader compatibility-sensitive harness contract; source review cannot decide which permanent product boundary maintainers want.

options.title: Approve built-in-only scope
options.body: Keep the documented fail-closed behavior for non-built-in harnesses and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Add a harness capability contract
options.body: Pause merge until supported harnesses can declare and enforce the same round-limit semantics through an approved API.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer this branch while keeping the canonical feature request open for a future runtime-budget design.

recommendation.title: Approve built-in-only scope
recommendation.body: Keep the documented fail-closed behavior for non-built-in harnesses and require exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged feature history and prior review work cover both tool-loop policy and the agent-core runtime boundary requiring this decision.
